label: sec:strangelet-intro
html:
In the lepton-partner reading of the quark sector (knot–particle dictionary), the strange quark's partner T_{2,5}^\sigma carries five crossings whereas the down quark's partner T_{2,3}^\sigma carries three; the quarks themselves are unknot strands of \mathcal{B}_3. Although the additional crossings increase the local strong pairing energy by a factor of 4/3 per baryon and render equal-flavour (\mathfrak{u}, \mathfrak{d}, \mathfrak{s}) matter electrically neutral (Q = 0), the cinquefoil Jones polynomial at q_0 \approx 1.1100 carries a skein-energy cost roughly 93 times larger than the crossing-energy gain, ensuring that ordinary non-strange nuclear matter is the true ground state at zero external pressure.

Inside the cores of massive neutron stars, degenerate Fermi pressure overcomes this skein-energy threshold and drives a three-stage topological phase transition:

  1. Stage 1 — Borromean dissolution (\rho \gtrsim 2\rho_0): Under extreme baryon chemical potential, the three-strand Borromean confinement links \mathcal{B}_3 (whose hyperbolic complement volume \mathrm{Vol}(\mathcal{B}_3) = 8G \approx 7.32772 carries 99\% of the nucleon rest mass) begin to delocalize.
  2. Stage 2 — Hopf diquark condensation (\rho \gtrsim 5\rho_0): Liberated quark strands re-pair into two-component Hopf links \mathcal{L}_H with linking number \pm 1, whose antisymmetric colour–flavour orientation generates the color-flavor-locked (CFL) superconducting gap \Delta_{\mathrm{CFL}} [alford1999, witten1984]. Because the Hopf link complement is Seifert-fibered with \mathrm{Vol}(\mathcal{L}_H) = 0, the transition from Borromean baryons (749 skein units) to Hopf diquarks (3 skein units)—a factor of 250 in binding scale—drops the effective carrier mass while stiffening the equation of state toward the conformal sound-speed limit c_s^2 = 1/3.
  3. Stage 3 — The golden-ratio deconfinement wall (q_{\mathrm{local}} \to q_{\mathrm{gold}} = 1/\varphi^2): At the golden-ratio threshold, the elliptic fibre of Bring's surface degenerates and Milnor's triple linking invariant \bar\mu(123) jumps discontinuously from 1 (Borromean) to 0 (Hopf), producing sharp observable signatures in neutron-star mass–radius curves, binary merger gravitational-wave post-merger frequencies, and double-beta decay pathways.

In the two-stage confinement architecture of Confinement Operator Selection and Physical cluster chamber, drip-line monomer reduction, and the Hoyle triple-alpha bottleneck, Stages 1--3 act directly on the microscopic \mathrm{HeckeGS} generator alphabet rather than merely flipping toric binomial arrows at fixed vacuum q_0: as q_{\mathrm{local}} \to q_{\mathrm{gold}} = 1/\varphi^2, three-strand Borromean baryon columns dissolve out of the admissible alphabet while two-strand Hopf diquark columns x_{qq} enter with finite trace cost in the colour--flavour-locked phase.
